snippet_primary: "Both platforms charge roughly the same total fees. Both let you export email lists but not payment relationships. Both own the checkout flow and the member experience. The main difference is content format: Substack is built for writers, Patreon is built for everyone else."
subject_exact: Comparación Substack vs Patreon: fees totales aproximadamente iguales, ambos permiten exportar listas de email pero no relaciones de pago, ambos poseen el checkout y la experiencia de miembro; diferencia principal el formato (Substack para escritores, Patreon para el resto)
local_qualifiers: The main difference is content format
